note: Positioning per priority product. claims must be Product-OS-supportable; prohibited_claims enforced by validator. Mini Audit reflects confirmed 10000 RUB price, evidence-backed findings, NOT redesign/implementation/guaranteed growth.

positionings.problem: Your website gets visitors but few turn into requests, and it is unclear why.
positionings.differentiation: Evidence-backed findings on the path-to-request, fixed price, fast turnaround — diagnosis before spend.
positionings.value_proposition: For 10 000 ₽ you get a concrete, evidence-based list of what blocks requests on your site and the prioritized first steps to fix it.
limitations: findings depend on what is publicly observable

positionings.category: Online presence map for low-maturity businesses
positionings.problem: Customers cannot find you online and you have no owned place to send them.
positionings.differentiation: Maps WHERE you exist online (channels) and the first owned-presence step — distinct from a website audit.
positionings.value_proposition: A clear picture of where your business shows up online, the gaps, and the recommended first owned-presence step.

positionings.problem: Your business underperforms across several areas and you need a complete diagnosis, not a single-page check.
positionings.differentiation: Greater depth and breadth than Mini Audit — multiple channels, deeper evidence.
positionings.value_proposition: A thorough, evidence-based assessment across your channels with prioritized recommendations.

positionings.problem: You have nowhere of your own to send interested people.
positionings.differentiation: One focused owned page, quickly — a starting point, not a full site.
positionings.value_proposition: A single, clear owned page so you have a credible place to send prospects.

positionings.problem: You promote an offer but have no dedicated page that converts.
positionings.differentiation: A focused conversion page for a specific offer — distinct from a general start page or full site.
positionings.value_proposition: A dedicated landing page built around one offer and one clear action.

positionings.problem: You need a credible, complete web presence, not just one page.
positionings.differentiation: A complete, scoped website with clear ownership and process — bounded scope vs open-ended agency work.
positionings.value_proposition: A complete business website built to an agreed scope.
